message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "strict_modality_adherence_in_diagnosis", "description": "When diagnostic tools return negative or non-specific findings that contradict the clinical suspicion or prompt context, avoid hallucinating evidence from unprocessed modalities.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving differential diagnosis where available tools are limited to specific modalities (e.g., CXR only) but the case history or ground truth implies findings visible only in other modalities (e.g., CT).", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["differential_diagnosis"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the available tools (e.g., CXR classifier/report generator) return negative or non-specific results while the clinical picture suggests a diagnosis typically requiring advanced imaging (e.g., CT): (1) Explicitly acknowledge the limitation of the current modality in the reasoning; (2) Do NOT cite visual features from unprocessed images (e.g., 'Figure 2 CT') as evidence; (3) Base the final differential diagnosis on the combination of clinical history and the absence of specific findings in the available modality, noting that the diagnosis is presumptive due to modality constraints."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
